    )
    product = result.scalar_one_or_none()

            ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND,

    payload: OrderCreate,
    tenant_id: Annotated[str, Depends(get_tenant_id)],
    session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(get_session)],
) -> OrderResponse:
    # First, fetch all products and check existence
    product_ids = [item.product_id for item in payload.items]
    
    result = await session.execute(
        select(Product).where(
            Product.id.in_(product_ids),
            Product.tenant_id == tenant_id,
        )
    )
    products = result.scalars().all()
    
    if len(products) != len(set(product_ids)):
        # Check if any product is from another tenant
        product_dict = {p.id: p for p in products}
        for item in payload.items:
            if item.product_id not in product_dict:
                raise APIError(
                    status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
                    ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND,
                    f"Product '{item.product_id}' not found",
                )
    
    # Check stock sufficiency
    total_quantity = {}
    for item in payload.items:
        total_quantity[item.product_id] = total_quantity.get(item.product_id, 0) + item.quantity
    
    for product in products:
        required_qty = total_quantity[product.id]
        if product.stock < required_qty:
            raise APIError(
                status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                ErrorCode.INSUFFICIENT_STOCK,
                f"Insufficient stock for product '{product.sku}'. Required: {required_qty}, Available: {product.stock}",
            )

        id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
        tenant_id=tenant_id,
        status="PENDING",
        total_amount=0,
    )
    session.add(order)
    
    total_amount = 0
    for item in payload.items:
        product = product_dict[item.product_id]
        quantity = total_quantity[item.product_id]
        line_amount = product.unit_price * quantity
        total_amount += line_amount
        
        order_item = OrderItem(
            id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
            order_id=order.id,
            product_id=product.id,
            sku=product.sku,
            product_name=product.name,
            unit_price=product.unit_price,
            quantity=quantity,
            line_amount=line_amount,

    # Decrease stock atomically
    for product in products:
        product.stock -= total_quantity[product.id]
    
    await session.commit()
    
    # Load items for response
    result = await session.execute(
        select(Order)
        .where(Order.id == order.id)
        .options(selectinload(Order.items))
    )
    order_with_items = result.scalar_one()
    
    return OrderResponse.model_validate(order_with_items)

        .where(Order.id == order_id, Order.tenant_id == tenant_id)

    )
    order = result.scalar_one_or_none()

            ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND,
            "Order not found",
        )
    return OrderResponse.model_validate(order)


@router.post("/orders/{order_id}/cancel")
async def cancel_order(
    order_id: str,
    tenant_id: Annotated[str, Depends(get_tenant_id)],
    session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(get_session)],
) -> dict[str, str]:
    result = await session.execute(
        select(Order).where(Order.id == order_id, Order.tenant_id == tenant_id)
    )
    order = result.scalar_one_or_none()
    if not order:
        raise APIError(
            status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND,
            "Order not found",
        )
    
    if order.status != "PENDING":
        raise APIError(
            status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
            ErrorCode.INVALID_ORDER_STATE,
            f"Order is in state '{order.status}', only PENDING orders can be cancelled",
        )
    
    # Load items with products
    result = await session.execute(
        select(OrderItem)
        .where(OrderItem.order_id == order_id)
        .options(
            selectinload(OrderItem.order),
        )
    )
    items = result.scalars().all()
    
    # Fetch products to restore stock
    product_ids = list(set(item.product_id for item in items))
    result = await session.execute(
        select(Product).where(
            Product.id.in_(product_ids),
            Product.tenant_id == tenant_id,
        )
    )
    products = result.scalars().all()
    product_dict = {p.id: p for p in products}
    
    # Update order status
    order.status = "CANCELLED"
    
    # Restore stock
    for item in items:
        if item.product_id in product_dict:
            product = product_dict[item.product_id]
            product.stock += item.quantity
    
    await session.commit()
    
    return {"status": "cancelled"}
